title: Chocolate Chip Toasted Coconut Muffins
changes_from_base: Chocolate chips and desiccated coconut replace the blueberries in a lightly sweet melted-butter batter, with toasted coconut on top.
summary: Lightly sweet muffins with chocolate chips through the crumb and toasted coconut on top.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line 10 holes of the tin.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, 45 g of the coconut and the sugar in a bowl, then toss in the chocolate chips so they are coated.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: Beat the melted butter, milk, egg and vanilla with a fork, then fold into the dry mix with a spatula until just combined; lumps are fine.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spoon into the cases, scatter the remaining 25 g coconut over and bake 25-30 min, until well risen and the coconut is toasted golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Rest in the tin for 10 min, then take them out; they are best warm.

tips: The most common mistake is pulling them early; wait for the coconut to turn golden so the centres are cooked.
Coating the chips in flour helps stop them sinking.
Use unsweetened desiccated coconut; the muffins have little sugar so it stays balanced.
storage: Keep in an airtight box for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
